basics.name: Eugene Hyrol
basics.label: Senior Mobile & Software Engineer
basics.summary: Passionate Software Engineer specializing in high-performance mobile architectures, native iOS engineering (Swift, Objective-C), and scalable digital experiences. Committed to clean code, robust testing, and open-source contribution.

work.summary: Leading mobile architecture and native client development across enterprise and consumer mobile applications.
highlights: Architected scalable mobile solutions using Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine, reducing crash rates to below 0.05%.
Spearheaded modular architecture migration, cutting clean build times by 35% and accelerating feature delivery.
Implemented automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Fastlane for seamless App Store deployments.

work.summary: Developed and maintained feature-rich iOS applications, network protocols, and real-time audio/data streaming services.
highlights: Built custom low-latency networking modules utilizing UDP and audio protocols.
Collaborated closely with UX/UI designers and backend engineers to craft fluid, accessible interfaces.
Contributed performance fixes and features to core open-source iOS libraries.

work.summary: Developed client-side applications, integrated external APIs, and maintained code quality across multiple production releases.
highlights: Delivered 10+ iOS applications from inception to App Store publishing.
Refactored legacy codebases towards modern design patterns (MVVM / Coordinator).

projects.name: WalkieTalkie
projects.description: Real-time iOS audio streaming application communicating over UDP protocols with low latency and background processing support.
highlights: Custom audio buffer management and UDP packet streaming in Swift
Robust network reachability and background reconnection handling

projects.name: Data Visualization & Charting
projects.description: Open-source contributions and custom graphing modules improving interaction responsiveness and bug fixes in chart libraries.
highlights: Resolved highlight state management in bar and line charts
Streamlined touch gestures and dynamic scaling for mobile screens

projects.name: Personal Developer Portfolio & CV
projects.description: Lightweight, accessible, and fast personal developer hub hosted on GitHub Pages with automated CI/CD deployment.
highlights: Subpage-ready architecture with Astro and Tailwind CSS
Dark/Light theme persistence, SEO metadata, and print-ready PDF styling

education.description: Core foundation in algorithms, data structures, network protocols, and object-oriented software design.
